scientific_limitations_and_integrity.literature_limit: Full readable 2010 arXiv rendering examined; 2008 HAL version verified by metadata but its full text could not be read. Novelty is assessed against accessible material and searches, not globally certified.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.not_proved: A matching upper mixing bound, sharp entry-time asymptotics, or extensions to other update conventions.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proved: Exact maximum-cut recurrent set, parity-dependent complete communicating-class enumeration, uniform stationary law in the even-peripheral case, polynomial worst-case expected entry bound, and explicit exponential total-variation mixing lower bound for the recurrent chain.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.verification: A standalone standard-library program exhaustively tested 21 parameter pairs through eleven vertices; proof, not enumeration, establishes the unlimited-parameter result.
